# #453: D3DMetal GPU limits (WaveSize(64), 64-bit typed UAV atomics, bounded lock emulation).
# Loads the host d3d12.dll at run time; links no BetterXen shim. Shader headers are
# generated by shaders/compile.sh (DXC v1.9.2609) and committed.
add_executable(test_d3dmetal_gpu_limits main.cpp)
target_include_directories(test_d3dmetal_gpu_limits PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(test_d3dmetal_gpu_limits PRIVATE kernel32)
